caveats: Tax is as levied on today's roll records for each tax year; records retired since TY2018 are missing, so early years run low.
Historic in a year: designated by that year (district or landmark; undated designations count throughout).

Scenario: DC Policy Center (2022) total-value growth gap for residential buildings in pre-2006 districts, 2006-21 (6.2% vs 4.9% a year), compounded from 2006 onto those buildings' tax; carried past 2021 at the same rate. Includes new construction outside the districts; DCPC does not attribute the gap to designation.
Existing-stock line: DCPC's appreciation of buildings standing in 2006 (94% vs 85%, 2006-21).
Scaling tax by value ignores the homestead deduction and assessment cap, which do not scale.
Commercial, landmark-only and post-2006 district property gets no scenario: DCPC measured residential districts designated before 2006.
